content.description: High-capital efficiency AMM-based DEX on Mantle. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, AGNI Finance redefines how users interact with decentralized exchanges (dexs). The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Mantle to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, AGNI Finance stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
